subject: Guarding Stars
query: is guarding stars based on a book
title: Is Guarding Stars based on a book? Yes, Katherine Center's The Bodyguard
answer: Yes. Netflix's Guarding Stars, starring Leighton Meester and Jared Padalecki, is based on Katherine Center's 2022 novel The Bodyguard. It keeps the book's leads, bodyguard Hannah Brooks and movie star Jack Stapleton, but moves the story from Texas to Montana. It premieres on Netflix on Nov. 18, 2026.
body:
In the film, Hannah Brooks is a no-nonsense security agent assigned to protect Jack Stapleton, a movie star who is being stalked. The two pose as a couple while he spends the holidays at his family's ranch, and the act turns into a real romance, according to Netflix. The book's leads have the same names. Meester plays Hannah and Padalecki plays Jack. The film was called The Bodyguard during production.

The biggest change reported so far is the setting: the novel is set in Texas, while the film is set in Montana, according to What's on Netflix. Elizabeth Allen Rosenbaum directed, from a script by Erin Cardillo, Richard Keith, Gina Matthews and Grant Scharbo. Filming took place in Calgary, Alberta, from Dec. 4, 2025, to February 2026, with additional shooting in Vancouver.

The cast also includes Andie MacDowell, country singer Walker Hayes in his acting debut, Noah LaLonde, Toby Sandeman, Rachael Ancheril, wrestler Phil Brooks (CM Punk), singer Ava Max and Shaun Johnston.
in_the_news: Guarding Stars, Netflix's adaptation of Katherine Center's The Bodyguard, premieres Nov. 18, 2026.
